en.intro: Arjuna has just told Krishna his body is failing him. Now he tells Krishna what he sees around him. Listen for the signs he notices and the reason he gives for not fighting.
en.notice: Arjuna says he sees viparitanani, opposite or inauspicious signs. He says he sees no shreyah, no real good, in killing his own people in this battle.
en.next: Arjuna then tells Krishna he does not want victory, kingdom, or even life itself.
en.meaning: O Keshava, I see only inauspicious signs, and I see no good in killing my own people in battle.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने अभी कृष्ण को बताया कि उनका शरीर कांप रहा है। अब वे कृष्ण को बताते हैं कि उन्हें चारों ओर क्या दिख रहा है।
hi.meaning: हे केशव, मैं केवल विपरीत लक्षण देख रहा हूँ और मुझे युद्ध में अपने ही लोगों को मारकर कोई कल्याण भी नहीं दिखाई दे रहा है।
hi.notice: अर्जुन कहते हैं कि उन्हें विपरीतानि, यानी विपरीत या अशुभ लक्षण दिख रहे हैं, और वे स्वजनम्, अपने ही लोगों को मारने में कोई श्रेयः, कोई भलाई नहीं देखते।
hi.next: अर्जुन कहते हैं कि उन्हें न तो जीत चाहिए, न राज्य, और न ही सुख।

en.intro: Arjuna has just told Krishna his body is failing him. Now he tells Krishna what he sees around him. Listen for the signs he notices and the reason he gives for not fighting.
en.body: O Keshava, I see only inauspicious signs, and I see no good in killing my own people in battle. Arjuna says he sees viparitanani, opposite or inauspicious signs. He says he sees no shreyah, no real good, in killing his own people in this battle. Arjuna then tells Krishna he does not want victory, kingdom, or even life itself.
